item.title: Gettysburg isn’t just for history buffs and Civil War nerds. Plan your visit with this guide.
item.description: Gettysburg is best known for the bloody battle that turned the tide of the Civil War, but its history extends beyond that decisive bout. item.title: Drug plan middlemen face new oversight push as Pa. pharmacies close
item.description: HARRISBURG — Some Pennsylvania lawmakers want to give the state's top prosecutor more power to take on pharmacy benefit managers, the corporate middlemen that are frequently blamed for pharmacy closures across the state. item.description: HARRISBURG — A stipend aimed at getting more student teachers into Pennsylvania schools and easing the commonwealth’s educator shortage is working, education advocates and experts say. item.title: Josh Shapiro has a 15-to-1 fundraising advantage over Republican Stacy Garrity
item.description: HARRISBURG — Democratic Gov. Josh Shapiro outraised Republican Stacy Garrity by more than 15-to-1 in 2025. And the race is just getting started. Shapiro privately told top donors in January that he aims to raise anywhere from $90 to $100 million for his reelection. Such a total would break a state record that Shapiro himself set when he raised $68 million for his gubernatorial race in 2022. item.title: Pennsylvania deserves the truth. Help us keep delivering it.
item.description: We pay for our government, and it should answer to us. But too often, that’s not how it works. Records get buried. Agencies stonewall. Officials wait out the news cycle or attack reporters rather than answer hard questions. Spotlight PA files hundreds of public records requests every year, pushes back when the door slams shut, and publishes what we find — regardless of who it implicates.
